purpose: Collects a date as editable day, month and year segments in the user's locale order, with a calendar for picking visually. Values are ISO dates such as 2026-03-15.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Marks individual ISO dates unavailable, for example weekends

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error below the field; sets the error state

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new ISO date, or null when cleared

whenToUse: For a single date such as a start date, due date or birthday
When some dates are unavailable and the calendar should show it
whenNotToUse: For a date range — use two DatePickers until a range picker exists
For approximate times such as 'last week' — use Select
antiPatterns: Hiding the typed segments so keyboard users must use the calendar
Using a text input with a format hint instead

anatomy: Label above; a 40px field of day, month and year segments with a calendar IconButton; a calendar popover with a month heading, previous and next IconButtons and a grid of days; helper or error text
sizes: Field `size-control-md` (40px); day cells `size-control-md` square; popover padding `space-component-padding-md`
typography: Segments `type-body1-size` in tabular figures; month heading `type-h4-size`; weekday headers `type-overline-size`; day numbers `type-body2-size`
states: Field borders as Input; focused segment `color-container-primary`; selected day `color-interactive-default` with `color-text-inverse`; today outlined in `color-border-interactive`; unavailable days at `opacity-disabled` and struck through
motion: Popover enters with `motion-easing-enter` and exits with `motion-easing-exit`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: The field is a group named by the label; each segment is a spin button (Arrow Up and Down change it, typing digits fills it)
The calendar is a dialog with a grid: arrows move by day and week, Page Up and Down by month, Enter selects
Order and month names follow the user's locale; unavailable dates are announced as unavailable
